the Women's Health Study has shown that vitamin E does not reduce coronary heart disease or stroke, but may reduce the risk of prostate cancer in men, and that the Women's Antioxidants and Folic Acid Trial has shown that vitamin C, vitamin E, beta-carotene, and folic acid do not reduce cardiovascular disease, and may even slightly increase cardiovascular disease.
